yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我深化了强化学习的应用场景：不仅在后期，也可在预训练阶段用于提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性，并认为用多样化合成数据训练的小模型可媲美前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner; design tools evolve with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；设计工具以代码为源不断发展。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副业项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文窗口被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：语言模型上的强化学习没有上限；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; agents' reliability, not capability, is the main bottleneck for adoption.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；智能体的可靠性而非能力是采用的主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; simplest RL methods work best; Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：强化学习是新的扩展轴；最简单的 RL 方法最有效；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work is managing agent teams; compute is bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队；算力是瓶颈。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool; invest early to stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年间，品牌策略从动态表达平台演变为招聘工具；强调早期投入以脱颖而出。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow capability.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权以提升能力。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化设计评审，偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；流程应适应问题而非模板。

truell.en: Natural language is not the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不是编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要的 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是出于速度和成本原因。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but we don't understand their inner workings—it's like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为扩大模型规模（Scaling）能提升智能，但神经网络内部机制如同炼金术，难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, but it alone won't achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展（inference-time compute scaling）是近期关键，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI，智能体式能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: We are not running out of text data; better training objectives can extract more from existing data, and models should learn by acting in the world.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他反驳数据枯竭论，认为改进训练目标可挖掘更多数据价值，并主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are shrinking the gap with frontier models; top-down compute allocation misses breakthroughs, so bottom-up is essential.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型缩小了与前沿模型的差距，并强调自下而上的算力分配对突破性想法至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as a self-accelerating AI application.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品，且编码作为 AI 自我加速的应用也被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research under-explored. PhD in ML best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；机器学习博士是成为安全研究员的最佳路径；人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight using AI to help humans. Interpretability key; automated alignment research can bootstrap progress.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督，用 AI 辅助人类评估；可解释性是关键，自动化对齐研究可迭代推进进展。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管变得必要。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号；强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning patterns to non-language tasks; warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，发现预训练语言模型可迁移推理模式到非语言任务；仓储机器人需达到 99.9%的可靠性。

abbeel.en: Simulation and RL are feasible for real-world robot control; human-robot interaction benefits from natural anthropomorphism.
abbeel.zh: 始终认为，模拟和强化学习可应用于真实机器人控制；人机交互受益于自然的拟人化倾向。
